description: Ballarat Footpaths is a dataset listed in Ballarat open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes the type and location of footpaths located in Ballarat. The information was collected as the footpaths were constructed. The intended use of the information is to inform the public of the locations of Ballarat's footpaths. This dataset is typically updated weekly on an automated schedule. Coverage: Ballarat, Victoria. The portal files it under Transport, Roads & Planning, Council Service Performance. Its keywords are footpath, path, sidewalk. The portal shows 7,079 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ballarat-vic-gov-au-portal.
